create_ParityCheck: create a ParityCheck task instance that counts the number of 1s in a binary string modulo 2
run_ParityCheck_sample_batch: run the ParityCheck sample_batch method to generate a jittable batch of binary strings and their parity labels
test_ParityCheck_input_size: test the ParityCheck input_size property which returns the embedding dimension of 2
test_ParityCheck_output_size: test the ParityCheck output_size property which returns the classification dimension of 2
review_ParityCheck: review the ParityCheck class that extends GeneralizationTask for parity classification
